headline: Council appointed members to Design Advisory Board, Development Review Board, and Public Works Commission.
summary: The council made four board and commission appointments. It appointed Joel Banner Baird and voted to re-post a second Design Advisory Board alternate position instead of appointing Alice Lissarrague. It also appointed Marina Campbell Loughlin to the Development Review Board and Johnathon Benoit to the Public Works Commission.
decisions: Appointed Joel Banner Baird to the Design Advisory Board as an Alternate Member, term expiring June 30, 2029.
Voted to re-post the Design Advisory Board alternate position instead of appointing Alice Lissarrague, 5-3-3 with 2 absent.
Appointed Marina Campbell Loughlin to the Development Review Board, term expiring June 30, 2027.
Appointed Johnathon Benoit to the Public Works Commission, term expiring June 30, 2027, by a vote of 7-4-2.

decision_evidence.quote: Joel Banner Baird was appointed to the Design Advisory Board as an Alternate Member, term expiring June 30, 2029.
Motion to re-post the position passed: 5:3:3:2.
Marina Campbell Loughlin was appointed to the Development Review Board, term expiring June 30, 2027.
Johnathon Benoit was appointed to the Public Works Commission, term expiring June 30, 2027: 7:4:2.
